Challenger Gets Bid From Daiichi Life Valuing Its Equity at $5.54 Billion
SYDNEY--Challenger said it is considering a takeover bid from Japanese insurer Daiichi Life Group that values its equity at 7.97 billion Australian dollars, equivalent to US$5.54 billion.
Challenger said Daiichi Life is offering A$11.80 per share for all of the stock that it doesn't already own. Daiichi Life is Challenger's largest shareholder with an around 20.5% stake.
The bid represents a roughly 20% premium to Challenger's closing share price of A$9.85 on Friday.
Challenger said the proposal has several conditions including due diligence, approval from regulatory bodies, and board recommendation.
